description: This file defines an Android Notification Listener Service for handling device notifications, tracking, filtering, and performing actions such as opening, dismissing, or replying to notifications. It manages notification state internally, serializes notification data, and communicates changes via an event sink.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a single notification with properties like key, package, title, text, and timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of active notifications including whether notifications are enabled and connected, along with a list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Request data class for performing actions on notifications such as opening, dismissing, or replying.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Result data class indicating success or failure of a notification action.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationStore
classes.description: Internal singleton managing in-memory and synchronized storage of notification entries and connection state.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: Android service extending NotificationListenerService that handles notification posting/removal, maintains notification state, and performs actions.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims notification text to a maximum character count.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Serializes a notification entry to JSON.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles initialization when the notification listener is connected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the listener is disconnected.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Handles new notifications, updates internal store, and emits change events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationRemoved
methods.description: Handles notification removal and emits change events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.notificationChangedPayload
methods.description: Constructs a JSON payload representing notification change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.refreshActiveNotifications
methods.description: Refreshes the internal store with current active notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.toEntry
methods.description: Converts a StatusBarNotification to internal notification entry format.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Performs specified actions (open, dismiss, reply) on notifications.
